writing.prompt_sv: Skriv till en vän vilken dryck du ville beställa och om du valde att sitta kvar eller ta med den. Skriv också om hämtning eller sittplats fortfarande är oklart. Beskriv det som faktiskt blev bestämt eller fortfarande är öppet. Du kan också skriva att du tackade nej.

intents.meaning_en: I will wait here.

writing.prompt_sv: Skriv instruktioner om växten och tacka för hjälpen. Berätta om tiden för nyckeln blev bestämd. Använd påhittade uppgifter. Beskriv det som faktiskt blev bestämt eller fortfarande är öppet. Du kan också skriva att du tackade nej.

missions.assessment_limit: Deterministic pattern recognition validates a narrow task intention, not broad language competence. Unsupported inputs request clarification. No pronunciation, official grade or calibrated ability score.
missions.learner_brief_en: Fictional task facts: Could you water my plant? I am going away this weekend. Use fictional names, codes and addresses. No real booking or purchase is made.
missions.response_guidance_en: Communicate the task facts in Swedish, then choose an offered option. This is guided practice with limited recognised phrasing; a clarification is not a judgement of your Swedish.
missions.recognition_limit_en: This guided conversation recognises a reviewed set of common replies. A request to rephrase can reflect an app limitation, even when your Swedish is correct.

missions.opening_en: Hi! What do you need?

character.name: Samira

missions.learner_brief_en: Fictional task facts: Could I borrow your screwdriver? I need to fasten a handle. Use fictional names, codes and addresses. No real booking or purchase is made.
missions.response_guidance_en: Communicate the task facts in Swedish, then choose an offered option. This is guided practice with limited recognised phrasing; a clarification is not a judgement of your Swedish.
missions.recognition_limit_en: This guided conversation recognises a reviewed set of common replies. A request to rephrase can reflect an app limitation, even when your Swedish is correct.

missions.description: Explain a noise problem respectfully.
missions.goal: Explain a noise problem respectfully.
missions.opening_sv: Hej! Är det något du vill prata om?
missions.opening_en: Hi! Is there something you would like to talk about?

character.name: Samira
character.persona: Respectful adult conversation partner. Only authored Swedish replies are used.

examples_sv: Det hjälper om du sänker volymen.

intents.meaning_en: It would help if you lowered the volume.

steps.hint_en: It would help if you lowered the volume.

steps.prompt_sv: Kan du säga till om det fortfarande hörs för mycket?

intents.reply_sv: Tack, jag sänker nu. Säg till om det behövs mer.
intents.feedback_en: Your meaning: I will let you know if the noise still bothers me.
intents.meaning_sv: Jag säger till om det stör.
intents.meaning_en: I will let you know if the noise still bothers me.
exact_replies_sv: Jag säger till om det stör.
Ja, jag säger till om det stör.
Ja, jag hör av mig om det fortfarande hörs.
intents.reference_question_sv: Kan du säga till om det fortfarande hörs för mycket?

intents.reply_sv: Okej, du behöver inte återkomma om ljudet. Jag sänker volymen som jag sa.

intents.meaning_sv: Jag säger nej till att lova att säga till om ljudet.
intents.meaning_en: I am not agreeing to report whether the noise is still too loud.
exact_replies_sv: Ja, men jag vill helst inte.
Jag vill helst slippa säga till igen.
Nej, jag vill helst slippa säga till igen.

listening.prompt_sv: Jag behöver borra en kort stund. Passar det bättre före lunch eller efter tre?
listening.question_en: Which time options are offered?

writing.prompt_sv: Skriv ett vänligt meddelande om ett ljudproblem och föreslå en lösning. Beskriv det som faktiskt blev bestämt eller fortfarande är öppet. Du kan också skriva att du tackade nej.
writing.prompt_en: Write a friendly message about a noise problem and suggest a solution. Describe what was actually agreed or is still open; you may say that you declined.

recall.prompt_sv: Beskriv ett problem utan att anklaga personen.
recall.prompt_en: Describe a problem without accusing the person.
recall.transfer_en: Ask a housemate to take a call elsewhere while you study.

missions.assessment_limit: Deterministic pattern recognition validates a narrow task intention, not broad language competence. Unsupported inputs request clarification. No pronunciation, official grade or calibrated ability score.

missions.recognition_limit_en: This guided conversation recognises a reviewed set of common replies. A request to rephrase can reflect an app limitation, even when your Swedish is correct.

missions.assessment_limit: Deterministic pattern recognition validates a narrow task intention, not broad language competence. Unsupported inputs request clarification. No pronunciation, official grade or calibrated ability score.

missions.recognition_limit_en: This guided conversation recognises a reviewed set of common replies. A request to rephrase can reflect an app limitation, even when your Swedish is correct.

missions.assessment_limit: Deterministic pattern recognition validates a narrow task intention, not broad language competence. Unsupported inputs request clarification. No pronunciation, official grade or calibrated ability score.
missions.learner_brief_en: Fictional task facts: I am happy to eat vegetarian food. I can buy vegetables on the way. Use fictional names, codes and addresses. No real booking or purchase is made.
missions.response_guidance_en: Communicate the task facts in Swedish, then choose an offered option. This is guided practice with limited recognised phrasing; a clarification is not a judgement of your Swedish.
missions.recognition_limit_en: This guided conversation recognises a reviewed set of common replies. A request to rephrase can reflect an app limitation, even when your Swedish is correct.

missions.title: Share a cost fairly
missions.description: Raise a cost question and explain a fairness concern.
missions.goal: Raise a cost question and explain a fairness concern.
missions.opening_sv: Vi behöver material till festen. Hur gör vi?
missions.opening_en: We need materials for the party. How shall we do it?

character.name: Liv
character.persona: Respectful adult conversation partner. Only authored Swedish replies are used.

steps.prompt_sv: Vi behöver material till festen. Hur gör vi?
steps.prompt_en: Raise a cost question and explain a fairness concern.
steps.objective_label: Raise a cost question and explain a fairness concern.

examples_sv: Hur ska vi dela på kostnaden?
intents.reply_sv: Vad är viktigt när vi delar kostnaden?
intents.feedback_en: Raise a cost question and explain a fairness concern. Your reply supplied the required information.
intents.meaning_sv: Hur ska vi dela på kostnaden?
intents.meaning_en: How should we share the cost?
exact_replies_sv: Hur ska vi dela på kostnaden?
Kan vi prata om hur vi delar på utgifterna för festen?

steps.unknown_reply_sv: Jag är inte säker på vad du menar. Kan du säga det på ett annat sätt?

steps.hint_en: How should we share the cost?

steps.prompt_en: Explain a fairness concern.
steps.objective_label: Explain a fairness concern.

examples_sv: Jag vill att alla ska kunna vara med.
intents.reply_sv: Vi kan sätta ett maxbelopp eller låta alla bidra på sitt sätt. Vad föredrar du?

intents.meaning_en: I want everyone to be able to take part.
exact_replies_sv: Jag vill att alla ska kunna vara med.
Jag tycker att alla ska ha möjlighet att vara med.

steps.unknown_reply_sv: Jag är inte säker på vad du menar. Kan du säga det på ett annat sätt?

steps.hint_en: I want everyone to be able to take part.

steps.prompt_sv: Vi kan sätta ett maxbelopp eller låta alla bidra på sitt sätt. Vad föredrar du?

steps.objective_label: Respond to the available options.

intents.reply_sv: Jag föreslår högst femtio kronor per person. Känns det rimligt?
intents.feedback_en: You selected a concrete option; the next reply follows that choice.
intents.meaning_sv: Vi kan sätta ett maxbelopp.
intents.meaning_en: We can set a spending limit.
exact_replies_sv: Vi kan ha ett tak för kostnaden.

examples_sv: Alla kan bidra på sitt sätt.
intents.reply_sv: Någon kan ordna musik och någon kan ta med material. Vill du att vi frågar gruppen?
intents.feedback_en: You selected a concrete option; the next reply follows that choice.
intents.meaning_sv: Alla kan bidra på sitt sätt.
intents.meaning_en: Everyone can contribute in their own way.
exact_replies_sv: Alla kan bidra på sitt sätt.
Var och en bidrar efter förmåga.
Alla får bidra på det sätt som passar.
Vi låter alla hjälpa till på sitt sätt.

steps.prompt_sv: Känns det rimligt?
steps.prompt_en: Does that seem reasonable?

intents.reply_sv: Då föreslår vi högst femtio kronor per person för gruppen.

intents.reference_question_sv: Känns det rimligt?

intents.reply_sv: Okej, då är det maxbeloppet inte överenskommet.

intents.meaning_en: I am saying no to the proposed spending limit.

Det blir för dyrt för mig.
Nej, det blir för dyrt för mig.
Jag har inte råd med det.
Nej, jag har inte råd med det.

reading.text_sv: Förslag: högst 50 kr per person. Den som vill kan bidra med arbete. Beslut tas på mötet.
reading.question_en: Is the proposal already decided?
reading.context_en: A separate message in the same everyday setting. Its details may differ from your conversation.

listening.prompt_sv: Vi har redan stolar och bord. Bara dekorationerna behöver ordnas.
listening.question_en: What still needs arranging?

writing.prompt_sv: Föreslå hur en grupp kan dela en kostnad. Ge en anledning. Beskriv det som faktiskt blev bestämt eller fortfarande är öppet. Du kan också skriva att du tackade nej.
writing.prompt_en: Suggest how a group can share a cost and give a reason. Describe what was actually agreed or is still open; you may say that you declined.

recall.prompt_sv: Ta upp pengar respektfullt.
recall.prompt_en: Raise a money question respectfully.
recall.transfer_en: Discuss sharing the cost of a group gift.

progression.repeat_prompt: Try again with the other option, then try without phrase hints. New attempts remain separate.
progression.unlock_policy: Recommended order only; all tasks remain accessible.

missions.assessment_limit: Deterministic pattern recognition validates a narrow task intention, not broad language competence. Unsupported inputs request clarification. No pronunciation, official grade or calibrated ability score.
missions.learner_brief_en: Fictional task facts: Phone messages distract me while I read. I start replying and then lose my place in the text. I can put the phone in another room for a while. The benefit is better focus, but I might miss a call. If I expect an important call, I can turn off only group notifications. What do you think about trying it for three days? Use fictional names, codes and addresses. No real booking or purchase is made.
missions.response_guidance_en: Communicate the task facts in Swedish, then choose an offered option. This is guided practice with limited recognised phrasing; a clarification is not a judgement of your Swedish.
missions.recognition_limit_en: This guided conversation recognises a reviewed set of common replies. A request to rephrase can reflect an app limitation, even when your Swedish is correct.

missions.title: Restart after a missed routine
missions.description: Talk about a setback without treating it as failure.
missions.goal: Talk about a setback without treating it as failure.
missions.opening_sv: Du sa att din plan blev svår att följa. Vad hände?
missions.opening_en: You said your plan became difficult to follow. What happened?

character.name: Robin
character.persona: Respectful adult conversation partner. Only authored Swedish replies are used.

phrases.en: If I miss a session, I continue the next day.
phrases.usage: Plan recovery without doubling the burden.

phrases.sv: Skulle du vilja fråga mig hur det går på söndag?
phrases.en: Would you ask me how it is going on Sunday?
phrases.usage: Invite helpful support.

phrases.sv: Kan du förklara vad du menar?
phrases.en: Could you explain what you mean?
phrases.usage: Ask for clarification. The guided engine may offer its authored hint rather than understand unrestricted dialogue.

reading.text_sv: Ny plan: ett litet steg i taget. Markera vad du faktiskt gjorde, inte hur bra du tycker att du var. Vi följer upp på söndag.
reading.question_en: What should you record?
reading.context_en: A separate message in the same everyday setting. Its details may differ from your conversation.

listening.prompt_sv: Jag missade tisdagens pass, men fortsätter på torsdag. Jag behöver inte göra två pass samma dag.
listening.question_en: What does the speaker plan after missing Tuesday?
answer_ideas_en: Continue on Thursday, without doubling up.
listening.delivery: Hide the source text until an answer is submitted. Revealing it leaves listening unassessed.
listening.context_en: A separate message in the same everyday setting. Its details may differ from your conversation.

writing.prompt_sv: Skriv om ett påhittat avbrott i en rutin. Föreslå en mindre plan och en vänlig uppföljning. Beskriv det som faktiskt blev bestämt eller fortfarande är öppet. Du kan också skriva att du tackade nej.
writing.prompt_en: Describe a fictional interrupted routine, propose a smaller plan and a supportive follow-up. Describe what was actually agreed or is still open; you may say that you declined.

recall.prompt_sv: Förklara hur du börjar om efter ett avbrott.
recall.prompt_en: Explain how to restart after an interruption.
recall.transfer_en: Help a friend restart a reading habit after a busy month.

coaching.focus: Talk about a setback without treating it as failure.

progression.repeat_prompt: Try again with the other option, then try without phrase hints. New attempts remain separate.
progression.unlock_policy: Recommended order only; all tasks remain accessible.

missions.assessment_limit: Deterministic pattern recognition validates a narrow task intention, not broad language competence. Unsupported inputs request clarification. No pronunciation, official grade or calibrated ability score.
missions.learner_brief_en: Fictional task facts: I missed several practice sessions and want to restart. The plan took more time than I expected. I could start with five minutes at a time. The benefit is getting started, but I cover less. If I miss a session, I continue the next day. Would you ask me how it is going on Sunday? Use fictional names, codes and addresses. No real booking or purchase is made.
missions.response_guidance_en: Communicate the task facts in Swedish, then choose an offered option. This is guided practice with limited recognised phrasing; a clarification is not a judgement of your Swedish.
missions.recognition_limit_en: This guided conversation recognises a reviewed set of common replies. A request to rephrase can reflect an app limitation, even when your Swedish is correct.

missions.assessment_limit: Deterministic pattern recognition validates a narrow task intention, not broad language competence. Unsupported inputs request clarification. No pronunciation, official grade or calibrated ability score.
missions.learner_brief_en: Fictional task facts: I want as many people as possible to be able to attend. We need to consider people who find long walks difficult. We could investigate the park near the bus stop. The advantage is no entry cost, but the weather is uncertain. If it rains, we can use a backup room. Which place do you think is easiest to reach? Use fictional names, codes and addresses. No real booking or purchase is made.
missions.response_guidance_en: Communicate the task facts in Swedish, then choose an offered option. This is guided practice with limited recognised phrasing; a clarification is not a judgement of your Swedish.
missions.recognition_limit_en: This guided conversation recognises a reviewed set of common replies. A request to rephrase can reflect an app limitation, even when your Swedish is correct.

progression.repeat_prompt: Try again with the other option, then try without phrase hints. New attempts remain separate.
progression.unlock_policy: Recommended order only; all tasks remain accessible.

missions.assessment_limit: Deterministic pattern recognition validates a narrow task intention, not broad language competence. Unsupported inputs request clarification. No pronunciation, official grade or calibrated ability score.
missions.learner_brief_en: Fictional task facts: I want to compare an evening course with studying independently. I need more practice talking with others. A course can offer regular conversation and feedback. The advantage is structure, but there is less flexibility. If the schedule conflicts, I can practise with a language partner. Which option do you think gives the most conversation practice? Use fictional names, codes and addresses. No real booking or purchase is made.
missions.response_guidance_en: Communicate the task facts in Swedish, then choose an offered option. This is guided practice with limited recognised phrasing; a clarification is not a judgement of your Swedish.
missions.recognition_limit_en: This guided conversation recognises a reviewed set of common replies. A request to rephrase can reflect an app limitation, even when your Swedish is correct.

writing.prompt_sv: Skriv ett kort exempel på en styrka med situation, handling och resultat. Be en vän om en konkret fråga. Beskriv det som faktiskt blev bestämt eller fortfarande är öppet. Du kan också skriva att du tackade nej.
writing.prompt_en: Write a short strength example with situation, action and result; ask a friend for a specific question. Describe what was actually agreed or is still open; you may say that you declined.

recall.prompt_sv: Berätta samma exempel kortare och sedan med mer detalj.

progression.repeat_prompt: Try again with the other option, then try without phrase hints. New attempts remain separate.
progression.unlock_policy: Recommended order only; all tasks remain accessible.

missions.assessment_limit: Deterministic pattern recognition validates a narrow task intention, not broad language competence. Unsupported inputs request clarification. No pronunciation, official grade or calibrated ability score.
missions.learner_brief_en: Fictional task facts: I want to explain my strengths with a concrete example. I want to show that I can cooperate and listen. In a group task, I helped us divide the work. Details can make the example clear, but the answer may become long. If I lose my thread, I can summarise the main point. Can you say whether my example is easy to follow? Use fictional names, codes and addresses. No real booking or purchase is made.
missions.response_guidance_en: Communicate the task facts in Swedish, then choose an offered option. This is guided practice with limited recognised phrasing; a clarification is not a judgement of your Swedish.
missions.recognition_limit_en: This guided conversation recognises a reviewed set of common replies. A request to rephrase can reflect an app limitation, even when your Swedish is correct.

semantic_contract.question_sv: Vill du göra det före nästa vecka?

permitted_meanings: Explicitly decline the offered action, arrangement, item or condition.
Express an inability or an incompatible preference that clearly refuses this offer.
Clearly decide to defer the offered action or commitment for now, including asking for prerequisite discussion first. This does not assert a later plan.
not_entailed: A particular reason for the refusal.
A specific alternative action, item, place or time.
An intention to do it later.
Cancellation of earlier agreements outside this offer.
semantic_contract.uncertainty_boundary: Uncertainty alone does not establish refusal; the complete response must express a permitted meaning.
semantic_contract.example_inventory_role: Illustrative subtypes only. No shared alternative or reason is inferred from the examples.

steps.hint_sv: Ja, det går bra. / Nej, det passar inte.
steps.hint_en: Yes, that works. / No, that does not work.
steps.current_offer_sv: Då kan du notera faktisk tid och hur bytet fungerar. Vill du göra det före nästa vecka?

speech_act_policy.scope: Interpret the actual current offer and the learner response together.
speech_act_policy.surface_form_rule: A question, an uncertainty word, or an initial yes/no token is not a class by itself.
speech_act_policy.unresolved_case: If the response does not establish a permitted meaning, request clarification without calling the Swedish incorrect.
speech_act_policy.additional_content: An explicit current-offer answer can remain valid with harmless extra content. Additional text must be checked for contradiction or a change of scope, not rejected automatically.
speech_act_policy.refusal_scope: A denial about an unrelated object is not automatically a refusal of this offer. Interpret whether an initial yes/no independently answers the offer or belongs only to a correction or different topic.

permitted_meanings: Explicitly decline the offered action, arrangement, item or condition.
Express an inability or an incompatible preference that clearly refuses this offer.
Clearly decide to defer the offered action or commitment for now, including asking for prerequisite discussion first. This does not assert a later plan.
not_entailed: A particular reason for the refusal.
A specific alternative action, item, place or time.
An intention to do it later.
Cancellation of earlier agreements outside this offer.
semantic_contract.uncertainty_boundary: Uncertainty alone does not establish refusal; the complete response must express a permitted meaning.
semantic_contract.example_inventory_role: Illustrative subtypes only. No shared alternative or reason is inferred from the examples.

steps.unknown_feedback_en: The app did not recognise this reply. Your Swedish may be correct. Choose what you meant to continue. You can also try another wording or show an example; this does not reduce your progress.
steps.hint_sv: Ja, det går bra. / Nej, det passar inte.
steps.hint_en: Yes, that works. / No, that does not work.
steps.current_offer_sv: Då kan du fråga vilka delar som går att delta i på distans. Vill du skriva frågan i dag?

speech_act_policy.scope: Interpret the actual current offer and the learner response together.
speech_act_policy.surface_form_rule: A question, an uncertainty word, or an initial yes/no token is not a class by itself.
speech_act_policy.unresolved_case: If the response does not establish a permitted meaning, request clarification without calling the Swedish incorrect.
speech_act_policy.additional_content: An explicit current-offer answer can remain valid with harmless extra content. Additional text must be checked for contradiction or a change of scope, not rejected automatically.
speech_act_policy.refusal_scope: A denial about an unrelated object is not automatically a refusal of this offer. Interpret whether an initial yes/no independently answers the offer or belongs only to a correction or different topic.

objectives: Discuss a fictional travel trade-off and choose what to investigate next.
State an estimate with its limit.
Explain the value of the opportunity.
Compare benefit and cost in time.
Offer a realistic fallback.
Invite a view without delegating the decision.
Respond to the available options.
Would you like to do it before next week? / Would you like to write the question today?

phrases.sv: Jag vill jämföra restiden med möjligheten att lära mig mer.
phrases.en: I want to compare travel time with the opportunity to learn more.
phrases.usage: Discuss a fictional travel trade-off and choose what to investigate next.

phrases.sv: Jag provar resvägen en gång.
phrases.en: I will try the journey once.
phrases.usage: Choose this option only if it matches what you want to say.

phrases.sv: Jag frågar om ett digitalt alternativ.
phrases.en: I will ask about a digital alternative.
phrases.usage: Choose this option only if it matches what you want to say.

phrases.sv: Resan verkar ta fyrtio minuter åt varje håll.
phrases.en: The trip seems to take forty minutes each way.
phrases.usage: State an estimate with its limit.

phrases.sv: Jag skulle få träffa andra och öva praktiskt.
phrases.en: I would meet others and get practical practice.
phrases.usage: Explain the value of the opportunity.

phrases.sv: Fördelen är gemenskap, men nackdelen är mindre tid hemma.
phrases.en: The benefit is companionship, but there is less time at home.
phrases.usage: Compare benefit and cost in time.

phrases.sv: Om resan blir för lång kan jag fråga om deltagande på distans.
phrases.en: If the trip is too long, I can ask about remote participation.
phrases.usage: Offer a realistic fallback.

phrases.sv: Vad tycker du att jag bör kontrollera först?
phrases.en: What do you think I should check first?
phrases.usage: Invite a view without delegating the decision.

phrases.sv: Kan du förklara vad du menar?
phrases.en: Could you explain what you mean?
phrases.usage: Ask for clarification. The guided engine may offer its authored hint rather than understand unrestricted dialogue.

reading.text_sv: Resförslag: buss 25 minuter, byte 10 minuter, promenad 5 minuter. Tiderna är ett exempel, inte en resegaranti.
reading.question_en: How long is the example journey in total?
reading.context_en: A separate message in the same everyday setting. Its details may differ from your conversation.

listening.prompt_sv: Det digitala mötet är på onsdag. Den praktiska delen kräver ett besök på plats på lördag.
listening.question_en: Which part requires attending in person?
listening.delivery: Hide the source text until an answer is submitted. Revealing it leaves listening unassessed.
listening.context_en: A separate message in the same everyday setting. Its details may differ from your conversation.

writing.prompt_sv: Skriv en jämförelse mellan två alternativ. Skilj på säkra uppgifter och sådant du måste kontrollera. Beskriv det som faktiskt blev bestämt eller fortfarande är öppet. Du kan också skriva att du tackade nej.
writing.prompt_en: Compare two options and distinguish known facts from details you still need to check. Describe what was actually agreed or is still open; you may say that you declined.

recall.prompt_sv: Förklara en avvägning och välj en fråga att undersöka.
recall.prompt_en: Explain a trade-off and choose one question to investigate.
recall.transfer_en: Compare two fictional volunteer opportunities with different travel demands.

coaching.completion_note: Task completed means the authored communication objectives were attempted successfully in this guided exchange. It is not mastery, placement or a course pass.

progression.repeat_prompt: Try again with the other option, then try without phrase hints. New attempts remain separate.
progression.unlock_policy: Recommended order only; all tasks remain accessible.

missions.assessment_limit: Deterministic pattern recognition validates a narrow task intention, not broad language competence. Unsupported inputs request clarification. No pronunciation, official grade or calibrated ability score.
missions.learner_brief_en: Fictional task facts: I want to compare travel time with the opportunity to learn more. The trip seems to take forty minutes each way. I would meet others and get practical practice. The benefit is companionship, but there is less time at home. If the trip is too long, I can ask about remote participation. What do you think I should check first? Use fictional names, codes and addresses. No real booking or purchase is made.
missions.response_guidance_en: Communicate the task facts in Swedish, then choose an offered option. This is guided practice with limited recognised phrasing; a clarification is not a judgement of your Swedish.
missions.recognition_limit_en: This guided conversation recognises a reviewed set of common replies. A request to rephrase can reflect an app limitation, even when your Swedish is correct.

provenance.authorship: Original fictional dialogue, messages and exercises authored for BP5. No commercial lessons or national-test items copied.
provenance.curriculum_source: curriculum.json retains official sources, pages and framework versions. All task links are partial authored interpretations, not an educator-validated course.
provenance.review_status: Authored language/flow review plus deterministic engineering tests. No independent Swedish educator review, learner usability trial or learning-effectiveness validation has occurred.
provenance.evaluation: library_evaluation.json contains separately authored paraphrases and negatives. After first execution and corrections these are regression cases, not a permanently unseen set.
